steps.instruction:
Ingredients: 4 Ripe Bananas
85g Unsalted Butter, Melted
1/3cup Greek Yogurt
220g Brown Sugar
2 Large Eggs
2 tsp Vanilla Extract
255g All-purpose Flour
1 1/2 tsp Baking Soda
1/2 tsp Sea Salt
135g Chocolate Chips
Coarse/Turbinado Sugar (optional)
Heat the oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a 9-by-5-inch loaf pan with nonstick spray.
Place bowl on scale. Mash the bananas coarsely w/ a fork. Whisk in the yogurt.
Add the flour to the new bowl.
Combine the contents of the two bowls. Stir to combine.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan, and sprinkle the coarse sugar on top if using.
Bake until the edges of the loaf start to pull away from the edge of the pan, and a toothpick comes out with a few moist crums attached.

Transfer from the oven to a cooling rack and a run a knife around the edge of the banana bread.
Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before unmolding and cooling completely.
